image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a curved glass balustrade system. The primary visual element is a thick, light-colored wooden handrail that curves smoothly along the incline of the stairs. Instead of traditional vertical balusters, the railing is supported by large, transparent glass panels held in place by metal clamps or channels. In the background, a perforated metal ceiling or upper floor structure is visible, along with recessed lighting.

The way the wooden handrail connects to the lower structure is ambiguous. It appears to merge or float slightly rather than having a clear mechanical connection point, which is a common AI structural ambiguity.
